scope: Native engine, transfer and sound startup followed by native request producer (20-byte copies, flags, producer cursor and pending counts verified after every call), full-pool overflow rejection with unchanged pool/cursor/count, then native sound request processing, packing, synchronous transfer and command completion. Full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/MMIO/MACL equality at startup boundaries and processing; independent payload, padding, pool wrap, 32-record batch boundary, preservation of excess requests, counters and status assertions. Real initialized 256-record pool and allocated work object. Caller supplies command inputs, initial circular cursor, destination offsets and transfer mode; host MMIO model, no audio playback.
